# `vl man`

Print the man page (`vl man | man -l -`), or write one page per command into DIR

```text
vl man [OPTIONS]
```

Options:

| | |
|---|---|
| `--out-dir <DIR>` | Write `vl.1` and one `vl-<command>.1` page per command here |
